name: do-not-contact
description: Build and keep one do-not-contact list that every outreach system checks first, starting from your own description of who must never be contacted: people who said no, unsubscribed or bounced, customers, open deals, testimonial givers, friends, family and partners. Reads only the places you point to, saves the list in a Google Sheet or Notion, updates weekly, and checks lead lists before you send. If your CRM already holds it all, it says so and uses the CRM instead. From the NotLinear AI Growth Systems Bootcamp.
